metadata.remarks: Cloud Configuration and Posture defines the trust properties required to ensure cloud environments remain in an intended secure state over time. This pattern addresses the dominant cloud failure mode: configuration drift, over-permissive settings, and unmanaged posture divergence rather than software vulnerabilities.
